## 3. Metrics to fetch

6 metrics. Each line has its stored metricId and its own fallback query.

The metric lines are in `single-system-ubiquiti-unifi run card part 2`. Search for each part by name and run every line.

## 4. Report

Sections, in order: Executive Summary; Controller Identity & Version; Device Inventory (APs / Switches / Gateways); SSID & Wireless Security; Guest Network Audit; VLAN / Network Configuration; Local User & Admin Audit; Management & Remote Access; Hardware & Firmware Lifecycle; Recommended Actions; Data Gaps & Coverage Notes.

Thresholds: inspector_lastseen_days_max=7; controller_version_age_months_max=6; ap_firmware_age_months_max=6; switch_firmware_age_months_max=6; gateway_firmware_age_months_max=6; ssid_open_authentication_allowed=False; ssid_wep_or_wpa1_allowed=False; ssid_psk_weak_chars_max=12; guest_network_isolation_required=True; guest_network_password_required=False; default_admin_allowed=False; remote_access_required=True.

Report each metric's actual value. Show "No data" for empty values; never mark a control passing without a supporting value. A "No data" row is a coverage gap only if the control matters and no other row covers it.

Coverage table: metrics fetched / required, with data / no data counts. Internal audience: add a verification log, one row per call (seq, metricId, result shape, status).

### Insights and recommendations

| Pattern | Recommendation template |
|---|---|
| Controller version out of date | "UniFi controller <N> months old. Update — UniFi releases frequent security fixes." |
| Device firmware out of date | "<N> APs / switches / gateways with outdated firmware. Schedule update window." |
| Device offline | "<N> devices offline > <N> days. Triage — physical / network / PoE." |
| AP/device discontinued | "<N> devices on EOL / discontinued models. Refresh roadmap required." |
| Open SSID (non-guest) | "URGENT: <N> open SSIDs (non-guest). Configure WPA2 / WPA3." |
| WEP or WPA1 in use | "URGENT: <N> SSIDs use WEP / WPA1. Upgrade to WPA2 or WPA3 (preferred)." |
| Weak PSK | "<N> SSIDs use short / weak PSK. Rotate to ≥ 16-char passphrase or move to WPA-Enterprise." |
| Guest isolation off | "Guest network L2 isolation disabled. Enable per MSP baseline." |
| Guest auth none | "Guest network has no authentication. Configure captive portal." |
| Default 'ubnt' admin | "URGENT: 'ubnt' default admin enabled. Rename + rotate." |
| Admin without MFA | "<N> UniFi admins without MFA. Enforce via Ubiquiti SSO." |
| Remote access disabled | "Remote access (Ubiquiti SSO) disabled. Enable so MSP can manage." |
| UPnP enabled | "UPnP enabled. Disable on gateway." |
| SNMP weak | "SNMP weak community. Reconfigure." |
| Hidden SSID broadcast off | "<N> SSIDs hidden. Note: hiding ≠ security; review intent." |
